Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. India have progressed to become the first team to qualify from Group B. They have joined Bangladesh and England in the semifinals with the fourth team to be decided tomorrow. Sri Lanka and Pakistan will be battling it out for that spot at Sophia Gardens in Cardiff at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Join us for all the action. Until then, cheers and take care!

South Africa skipper, AB de Villiers says that this was not an ideal way to end the tournament as they lost in a disappointing way. Mentions that they wanted to keep calm and play a better brand of cricket. Reckons that the run outs cost them dearly today. Feels that they never got going today. Mentions that they were outdone by a better team. Ends by saying that nothing went their way and they also gave some runs in the field.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that it was a good toss to win and adds that the wicket didn't change much. Feels that their bowlers bowled well and the fielders backed them up. Mentions that these factors were instrumental in restricting such a strong team to 191. Opines that de Villiers' wicket was crucial as they know how terrific a player he is. Adds that his team stepped up in the field. States that it is important for someone to bat till the end. Reckons that Dhawan's intent was great to see. Further adds that Yuvraj also wanted to stay till the end and it will boost his confidence. Feels that the wicket in Birmingham suits their style of play. Stresses that they need to bring their A game to the fore. Feels there is always room for improvement and one shouldn't be complacent. Ends by saying that any game of cricket one plays, there is always something to learn.

Man of the Match, Jasprit Bumrah says that it was an important game for them and they executed the plans well which worked for them. Mentions that he is ready to execute any role in the team. Adds that he feels good as long as he is contributing. Informs that they were only trying to stick to basics and were looking to bowl good lengths. Feels that it was a good toss to win as chasing has been easier in this tournament.

The South Africa bowlers tried hard but it was a pretty low total that they were defending. Morkel and Tahir were the only ones who took a wicket apiece. Rabada was probing with the ball but the Men in Blue saw him through cautiously. Earlier, the top ranked side in the world didn't play like as if they were one. They collapsed to disappoint once again in a knockout. Kudos to the Indian bowlers and fielders for setting up the game nicely and to the batsmen for living up to their reputation.

An emphatic show from India and they book their place in the semi-final. The Indian openers, Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma showed intent from the beginning but a poor shot from the latter resulted in his downfall. The Indian skipper, Virat Kohli came out and took his time to get going. He was struggling a touch but got into his flamboyant self as he settled into his innings. Dhawan on the other end continued his dream run in the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy to become the leading run-scorer. His was a free flowing knock which kept the crowd thoroughly entertained. The 128-run stand between the duo almost sealed the deal for the Asian side.

SIX! INDIA WIN BY 8 WICKETS! Yuvraj finishes off in style! Shorter delivery angling into the pads, Yuvraj camps back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen. INDIA PROGRESS TO THE SEMIFINALS OF THE 2017 ICC CHAMPIONS TROPHY!
Fuller into the pads, Yuvraj comes down the track and goes for a biggie. However he fails to make contact as he gets rapped on the pads.
Full into the pads, Kohli clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Into the pads, Yuvraj clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller outside off, Yuvraj carves it through the backward point region for a couple.
Fuller outside off, Yuvraj drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Cut through cover-point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short delivery outside off, Kohli camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Shortish around off, Kohli camps back and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Clipped through square leg for a single.
Yuvraj Singh stays in his crease and defends it.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Yuvraj stays in his crease and tries to defend it. Gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball goes past the keeper. The batsmen run a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Yuvraj pushes it back to the bowler.
Yuvraj stays in his crease and defends it on the leg side.
Kohli clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Shorter outside off, Yuvraj punches it through covers for a single.
Quicker outside off, Kohli cuts it really late but still cannot beat the fielder at short third man.
Fuller around off, Yuvraj drives it towards long off for a single.

NOT OUT! Floats this one around middle and off, Yuvraj prods forward in defence and he gets rapped on his pads. Gets his bat behind his pad so not sure what made contact first. The players appeal and the umpire stays put. AB de Villiers consults Tahir and goes for the review. The replays roll in. After having a good hard look at it, the third umpire decides that there was an inside edge on that one. The on-field call stays.
AB de Villiers opts to go for the review against Yuvraj Singh. It is regarding an LBW decision.
Kohli drives it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller around leg, Kohli plays his trademark flick through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Wrong 'un outside off, Yuvraj cuts it towards point. Morris dives to his left and makes a fine stop. The batsmen run a single.
Drives it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli clips it towards long on for a single.
Full into the pads, Yuvraj drives it towards long on for a single.
Fuller into the pads, Yuvraj mistimes his sweep towards short fine leg.
Flatter around off, Kohli cuts it towards backward point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli camps back and punches it on the off side.
JP Duminy is introduced into the attack.
Drinks time. India are cruising towards victory. Just a matter of time now.

Huge shout for LBW! Quicker delivery into the pads, Yuvraj Singh goes back and tries to clip it on the leg side. Fails to make contact and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays undisturbed. AB de Villiers thinks of taking a review but decides otherwise. The Hawk Eye shows that it pitched outside leg.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller on middle, Yuvraj Singh stays in his crease and lofts that over the mid on region for a boundary.
Shortish outside off, Kohli cuts it through point for a single.
Eased towards long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Yuvraj drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Quicker one outside off, drifts away after pitching. Yuvraj tries to slog it on the leg side but he misses to make contact.
Fullish delivery outside off, Kohli mistimes his push down the track.
Angling in from a good length, Virat Kohli defends it neatly.
Fuller around off, Virat clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Virat pushes it to the fielder at covers.
Fuller around off, Kohli mistimes his drive towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery around off, Kohli defends it back to the bowler.
Punched through the cover region for a single to keep strike.
Short and a quicker one this time, Kohli pushes it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Wrong 'un around off, Yuvraj mistimes his cut towards point for a single.
Kohli gets a bit forward and clips it towards long on for a single.
Fuller around off, Kohli drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Yuvraj Singh walks out to the crease.

OUT! Finally something to cheer for the Proteas! Googly in line of the stumps, spinning away. Dhawan uses his feet and swings across the line. However, he gets it off the outer half of the bat towards wide long off. Du Plessis covers good ground to his right and bends low to take a fine catch. Back-to-back tons was there for the taking but the southpaw perishes. A brilliant knock nonetheless. India need 41 more runs to win.
Imran Tahir is back into the attack.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli dabs it behind point for two runs.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it down the track.
Shortish delivery outside off, Kohli bends a touch and looks to manufacture a ramp shot over the keeper but misses.
Fullish and straight this time, flicked to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on leg stump, Dhawan wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan taps it to covers.
Fullish ball on off, Dhawan eases it to mid off for an easy single.
Full length delivery outside off, Shikhar goes hard at it but mistimes it to covers.

That was pleasing to the eyes! Fullish delivery outside off, Kohli strokes it confidently past the diving short cover fielder. The ball rolls towards the fence as de Villiers chases it down. Three runs taken.
Back of a length outside off, cut hard to third man for a single.
In the air... but safe! Bouncer on off, Kohli miscues his pull over mid-wicket. Tahir charges in towards the ball but it falls down safely. A run taken.
On a fuller length around of, Kohli presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Good length delivery outside off, played with an angled bat to point for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Boom! Dhawan is stamping his authority now. Short delivery on off, Shikhar swats it over mid on for back-to-back boundaries.
Dhawan goes a bit leg side and Morris bowls a low full toss on off. The southpaw jams it to mid on.
FOUR! Dhawan is in the zone! Shortish outside off, Dhawan pulls it through mid-wicket to find the fence.
41st ODI fifty for Virat Kohli!

Well-deserved half century for the Indian skipper. He is leading from the front. Back of a length outside off, Kohli places it through point for a single. He struggled initially but has pressed on. He has played some flamboyant shots to keep the crowd entertained.
Angling into Kohli. He moves inside the line and tucks it to fine leg. Moves to 49.
Length delivery on off, Virat hangs back and defends it solidly down the track.
Very full on off, jammed out towards mid off for an easy single.
Length delivery on off, shapes in a touch. Dhawan shuffles across to play at it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Shikhar blocks it to the leg side.

FOUR! Streaky runs but Dhawan won't mind it! Short and down the leg side, Dhawan goes for the pull but gets it off the glove over the keeper. The southpaw picks up another boundary as the ball rolls to the fine leg fence.
Fullish in line of the stumps, clipped sweetly to mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery, shaping into Shikhar. He pulls it hard to deep mid-wicket for a run. Shoulders are drooping for the Proteas.
Fullish delivery around off, Dhawan checks his drive a bit and gets it uppishly to covers. Fortunately, it drops well short of Miller in that region.
100-run stand between Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli!
FOUR! Bang! Good length delivery on off, Dhawan heaves it across the line and does so convincingly. Gets it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller length ball on off, Kohli clips it towards wide mid on and sets off. Rabada dives to his right to make a good stop.
Fullish and angling into Dhawan. He turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, Kohli hops back and defends it nicely.
On a length outside off, Virat strides forward and pushes it to cover-point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point.

Good length delivery on off, Dhawan defends it beside the pitch on the off side. Kohli calls for the run but Dhawan says no. Rabada attacks the ball but misses his shy at the bowler's end. An extra run taken.

Good length delivery down the leg side, Dhawan moves inside the line and looks to tuck it. Misses and the ball brushes his pad to fly towards de Kock. He fails to stop it. Phehlukwayo in the deep cuts it off with a dive. Two leg byes taken.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Full length delivery outside off, driven past Morkel in his followthrough.
Short of a length delivery, Dhawan shuffles across and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish outside off, driven sweetly to covers.
19th ODI fifty for Shikhar Dhawan!

FOUR! Gets to his half century in style! He also becomes the highest run-scorer in this year's tournament. He had a dream run in  the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy in England and he is repeating the feat once again. Fuller length ball outside off, Dhawan shuffles and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Fulish delivery around off, Shikhar mistimes his drive to mid off.
Shortish delivery outside off, Dhawan goes for the cut but only manages to connect thin air.
Good length delivery outside off, zips through the surface. Kohli rises on his toes and defends it to the off side.
FOUR! Kohli is getting into the groove. Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli leans towards it and punches it through covers. Has struck that beautifully and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! Pure timing! Fullish delivery on off, Kohli brings his wrists into play and clips it through mid-wicket for an elegant boundary.
Fullish delivery and tailing in, clipped to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery, shoots off the pitch. Kohli hops back and defends it to the leg side.
Back of a length delivery, angling into Kohli. He shuffles and tucks it around the corner for a run to retain the strike.
Dug in short on off, Kohli goes for the hook but fails to make any connection.
Full length delivery outside off, Kohli drives it crisply to mid off.
Fullish delivery, Shikhar mistimes his push to covers. Decisive running and they get the run easily.
Fuller length ball around off, Dhawan plays it with an open face to gully.
Shortish outside off, cut to point.
Chris Morris is back on.
Similar length delivery outside off, played with an angled bat to gully. India need 92 runs from 174 balls.
FOUR! A bit risky but the Indian skipper will take it. Good length delivery outside off, Kohli steers it through the gap between first slip and gully to find the fence once again.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli looks to lift it over covers. Ends up slicing it over the backward point fielder and the ball rolls to the fence.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan pushes at it but gets an inside edge down to fine leg. A run taken.
Good running! Short of a length outside off, Kohli looks to guide it to third man but gets a bottom edge beside him. Calls for the single and his partner responds. Good judgement.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli opens the face of his blade and places it to point.
Morne Morkel is called back into the attack.
Shortish delivery on off, Dhawan drags his pull towards wide mid on.

FOUR! Hit with disdain! He is so good on square of the wicket on either side. Gets a short delivery and room is on offer. He cuts it authoritatively towards point. Miller dives to his right but the ball goes past him in a jiffy. Dhawan earns another boundary to his name.
Slower delivery outside off, Dhawan plays it with an angled bat to point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan goes for the cut but bottom edges it to to the keeper.
Good game awareness! Very full on off, Kohli jams it to mid on and sets off. Morkel rushes towards it but misses his shy at the bowler's end. Virat was easily in.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli drills it to covers.
Flatter on off, defended solidly.

FOUR! Well played! Picks the googly to perfection and gets the desired result. Tossed up around off, spinning away. Shikhar waits for it and cuts it nicely. Beats Amla at point to race across to the fence. He is getting better and better as the tournament progresses.
Short fine leg drops back.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On the shorter side and spinning into the pads, Dhawan hammers it through fine leg for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Googly outside off, Virat reads it and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Kohli stays leg side of the ball and drives it sweetly to covers.
Fullish delivery around off, Dhawan drives it towards the bowler who makes a half-stop.

Close shave! Dhawan uses his feet and Phehlukwayo bowls it on a back of a length in line of the stumps. Gets big on Shikhar as he attempts the pull. Miscues it completely as the ball spoons towards mid on. Morkel runs towards it but can collect it only on the bounce.
Slower delivery outside off, Dhawan chops it to the man at point.
Short of a length delivery in line of the stumps, Kohli moves inside the line to pull it but mistimes it through backward square leg. A run taken.
On a fuller length outside off, Virat leans towards it and strokes it sweetly to covers. He is picking out the fielders at the moment.
Fullish delivery, shaping into Kohli. He wrists it to mid-wicket.
Drinks time. A good start from India and they are looking comfortable in the middle. South Africa need a couple of quick wickets to get back into the game.

Not out! Quicker in pace and it's the googly again. Dhawan goes for the drive but gets foxed by the away spin. De Kock collects it cleanly and whips the bails off in a flash. He appeals and the decision is referred upstairs. The replays show that Shikhar dragged his foot outside for a moment but got it back in time.
There is a stumping appeal against Dhawan. Seems fine though.
Googly outside off, Shikhar reads it and guides it to short third man.
50-run stand for Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli!
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up delivery, Dhawan nails the sweep through square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Fullish on middle and leg, defended solidly.
A bit shorter on off, punched to covers.
Flatter delivery, punched past the diving fielder at mid on for a single.
Imran Tahir to start his spell.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Kohli clips it nicely towards wide mid on. Morkel goes to his right and dives but fails to stop it cleanly. Three runs taken.
Dhawan comes down the track and mistimes it to covers. A run taken.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid on where Morkel moves to his left to make a good diving stop.

Dropped! It was a good effort though. Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli goes at it with hard hands but gets an outside edge. The ball flies low towards Amla at first slip. He dives and gets a hand to it but when his hand hits the ground, the ball comes out. Unlucky for Hashim. South Africa need to keep bowing in this channel. The Indian skipper struggles in this area.
That is a jaffa! Good length delivery outside off, comes in sharply. Kohli shuffles across and plays at it. However, the ball whizzes through the gap between his bat and pad.
Length delivery around off, shaping in. Kohli mistimes it to covers.
Short delivery down the leg side, Dhawan goes for the hook shot but he fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli guides it a bit wide of point for a quick single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli dabs it straight to the fielder at gully.
Fuller outside off, Kohli clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Wide! Morris gets his line wrong this time. Sprayed down the leg side, Kohli fails to clip it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller around off, Kohli leans into the drive and hits it through the mid on region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan cuts it towards third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Kohli defends it towards the fielder at gully.
A bit of drizzle is in the air. Let's hope it is a passing shower.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli comes a bit forward and guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Fuller outside off, Kohli mistimes his cut towards the fielder at gully.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan pushes it towards long off and scampers across for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, Kohli punches it through covers for a single.
SIX! Does it get any better? On a length around off, Kohli charges a bit down the track and lofts it straight down the ground. Over the long off region for a biggie.
Short delivery into the body, Dhawan defends it on the leg side.

In the air...just short! Short delivery into the body, Kohli pulls it towards fine leg. Morkel the fielder there, comes charging in, dives forward but the ball falls just short of him. A single is taken.
Short outside off, Kohli stands tall and defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller around off, Kohli gets an inside edge into the pads.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Fuller into the stumps, Kohli clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Change of gloves for Dhawan. Meanwhile, Chris Morris is brought into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, Dhawan punches it towards the fielder at mid off.

Angling into the stumps from a length around off, Kohli comes down the track and tries to flick on the leg side. Gets an inside edge into the pads and the ball goes towards square leg. A single taken.
Length outside off, Kohli pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller into the stumps, Kohli clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Beaten! Length delivery outside off, jags in. Kohli has a poke at it but is beaten on the inside edge. That was a peach.

Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan places it towards point. Miller fails to cut it with a dive and the ball runs through. Perhaps he got a bit of bad bounce there but he needs to stop those. The batsmen run three.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes into the attack.

Fuller and down the leg side, Dhawan fails to clips it through. Gets rapped on the pads and the ball goes on the leg side. The umpire gives it as a run so maybe there was some bat involved. There was a direct hit at the striker's end too but no damage in the end.
Full into the pads, Dhawan flicks it through the backward square leg region. Phehlukwayo fumbles a bit which allows the batsmen to run two.
Short around off, Dhawan punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Into the hips this time, Kohli shuffles across and clips it towards the fine leg region for a single.
Fuller around off, Kohli pushes it straight back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it towards the fielder at point.
Powerplay 2 has been taken. Maximum of four fielder are now allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Length delivery and angling across, Dhawan covers his stumps and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Full toss outside off, Dhawan carves it over the point fielder for a couple.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! Back of a length this time, in the line of the stumps. Dhawan defends it and the umpire signals a no ball for over stepping. South Africa surely cannot afford these.
Good length in the line of the stumps, Dhawan defends it on the pitch.

FOUR! That's lovely! On a length around off, Dhawan strokes it uppishly through the cover region. Miller gives it a chase, puts in a dive but he cannot stop the ball from reaching the fence. Back-to-back boundaries for Shikhar.
FOUR! Full delivery outside off, Dhawan strides into the ball. Punches down the ground, beats the diving AB de Villiers at mid off and goes for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan creams it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Shortish around off, Kohli guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan guides it towards third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it on the off side with soft hands and rushes across for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli dabs it towards the fielder at gully.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli shuffles and punches it towards the fielder at mid on.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it towards the fielder at point.
Short delivery outside off, Dhawan tries to poke at it but is beaten by the away movement. Back-to-back maidens for South Africa.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan mistimes his drive towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan slams it straight towards the fielder at covers. No runs taken.
Fuller into the stumps, Dhawan clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, Dhawan defends it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli stays in his crease and lets the ball through. Maiden from Rabada.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli dabs it towards the fielder at gully.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli shuffles across and defends it on the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, Virat punches it towards the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli shuffles across and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller around off, Dhawan glides it towards the fielder at point.
Length delivery into the stumps, Dhawan clips it towards mid on. Calls for a single but Kohli is quick to send him back.
Angling into the batsman, Kohli clips it towards fine leg for a single to get off the mark.
The skipper, Virat Kohli comes out to bat. There is a huge cheer from the crowd. A slip and a gully in place for him.

OUT! Morkel strikes! Length delivery and angling into the batsman,  Rohit Sharma goes leg side and tries to hit it over the infield. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies to the keeper. Quinton de Kock is wrong footed initially but does well to stretch to his right to take a good catch. Sharma has to walk back to the hut.
Fuller on middle and off, Rohit clips it off the inner half to front of square on the leg side.
Dug in short into the batsman, Sharma goes for the pull. Does not make contact as the ball goes straight to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan opens the face of the bat and guides it towards the fielder at point.
Good length delivery around off, Dhawan defends it well off the back foot.

FOUR! Poor fielding by Phehlukwayo! Short delivery into the body, Dhawan pulls it towards fine leg. Phehlukwayo in the deep runs to his left and tries to cut it off but ends up over running it which allows the ball to race away to the fence.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan punches it towards the fielder at point.

Fuller outside off, Sharma drives it towards wide mid off and rushes across for a quick single. The mid off fielder cuts it off and has a shy at the striker's end. He misses and the ball goes through to the fielder at fine leg. No runs on overthrow as Morkel covers it well.
Short outside off, Sharma punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller around off, Dhawan defends it on the off side.
Good length delivery around off, Dhawan stays in his crease and defends it.
SIX! What a shot, Dhawan! Fuller into the pads, Dhawan flicks it beautifully over the square leg region. Times it impeccabbly well as the ball sails deep into the stands for a maximum.
Fuller outside off, Dhawan plays a crispy drive but straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery around off, Dhawan tries to push at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shikhar Dhawan stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
SIX! Sharma is on the charge! Short delivery into the body, Sharma camps back and goes for the pull. Gets it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen. Good over this for India. 10 runs off it.
FOUR! Typical Sharma this time! Fuller into the stumps, Sharma drives it straight down the ground through mid on for a boundary.

Peach of a delivery! Short delivery outside off, Sharma tries to sway away and play the cut. Gets cramped for room as the ball swings in and he is lucky not to edge it. Luck isn't going the Proteas' way.
Sharma stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma tries to defend it but he fails to make contact as he is beaten by the away movement.
Good length delivery outside off, Sharma camps back and punches it towards the fielder at covers. Miller dives to his right to make a fine stop.
Length delivery around off, Dhawan tries to defend it but ends up getting a leading edge towards the fielder at covers.
Short cover in place.
Good length delivery outside off, Sharma dabs it towards third man for a single. First runs for Rohit.
Fuller around middle and leg, Rohit clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Sharma gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.

Silly running there again and Dhawan is very lucky to survive! Length delivery outside off, Dhawan defends it towards covers with soft hands. Calls for a single and Sharma responds too. Miller is quick to reach the ball and he throws it at the non-striker's end. He misses but had he hit, Dhawan was gone by a mile as he had given up. A single is taken.
Length delivery sprayed into the pads, Dhawan fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads.
Morne Morkel will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Maiden to start with from Rabada! Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma stays in his crease and defends it really well.
Another length delivery outside off, Sharma covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
That was a beauty! Good length delivery around off and nipping away. Rohit tries to feel it but gets beaten by the away movement.
Angling in from a good length around off, Sharma clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Sharma stands tall in his crease and defends it straight back.
Good length delivery outside off, swings away a touch. Rohit Sharma is undisturbed by that line as he lets that through to the keeper.

Welcome back for the chase! Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma will open the batting for India. Meanwhile, South Africa will start the proceedings with Kagiso Rabada. Two slips in place. Can the Proteas strike early? Here we go...
